title: Strawberry Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta
hookLine: Silky 4-ingredient cream pudding with a velvety wobble & fresh macerated strawberry coulis.

items.name: Unflavored gelatin powder (bloomed in 2 tbsp water)

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {cream_pc} and {gel_pc} and {sugar_pc} and {berry_pc} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Dissolve Gelatin in Warm Vanilla Cream
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat {cream_pc} and {sugar_pc} until steaming (not boiling), remove from heat, and whisk in bloomed {gel_pc} until crystal clear. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {sugar_pc} and {berry_pc} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Chill 3 Hours & Spoon Berry Coulis
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into glasses, chill 3 hours until gently jiggly, and top with {berry_pc}. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 8 mins.
